in_marathi.name: Suransh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suransh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Suransh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Surya', which means Sun. The name Suransh is a compound of two words 'Sur' meaning Sun and 'Ansh' meaning soul. The name Suransh signifies the Sun God, the one who illuminates the soul with the light of knowledge and wisdom.
